---
title: "BoolMore"
---

`boolmore` refines an existing Boolean model so that it agrees more closely with experimental perturbation-observation data. It searches Boolean functions that stay consistent with the starting interaction graph and known mechanistic constraints, and scores each candidate by how well its attractors match the observations.

* <https://github.com/kyuhyongpark/boolmore>

This page is a placeholder and a work in progress.
